text: Hey guys! The developer of this plugin contacted me by email.
It's so good I've been using it nonstop, so I had to make a video.
It's called Decky Direct Updater. If you use Decky Loader plugins
that aren't from the official Store, you'll know how awkward it can be
to update them sometimes. This plugin takes care of it for you.
It finds the Git repositories, checks the latest releases and installs them
directly through Gaming Mode into Decky Loader. That means
you can keep your official and unofficial Decky Loader plugins
up to date at the click of a button. To install it,
switch to Desktop Mode from the power menu. You can also do this
in Gaming Mode if you have a browser to get the command,
or copy and paste it into Decky Loader, as you'll see in a moment.
Go to deckyup.nukeador.com. Scroll down and copy the Direct Updater installation link.
Copy it to your clipboard, then open Big Picture Mode
on the desktop. Otherwise, you can't access the Decky Loader plugins
in Desktop Mode. This saves switching back to Gaming Mode. Open
the Decky Loader settings. Make sure Developer Mode is enabled
under General. Then, in the Developer menu, paste the URL into
the Install Plugin from URL box and press Install. There you go!
You now have an updater for your plugins. I've also found
lots of available updates for official plugins that haven't yet
made it through Decky Loader. You can stay as up to date as their Git
repositories. That's great for most people, and even better
for plugin developers: as soon as you push an update
to your repository, you can refresh here and install it directly
without messing around with URLs. There may be a new update soon for Decky
Multiframe Gen, but more on that in another video. Tell us
in the comments if there are other Decky Loader plugins you'd like to hear
about. We'll have another video on the best Decky Loader plugins
coming soon.
